name: Albireo no Namida ~Yokoshima Ryuu to Seiou no Ko~
original_name: アルビレオの涙～邪竜と聖王の子～
source:
In a world divided by good and evil, there lived two extremely beautiful princes.

Though both originally hailed from the same kingdom, one day the elder twin, Prince Afnan, vanished without a trace.

Prince Najaf of the Kingdom of Amjad, a realm that upholds righteousness and the inherent goodness of humanity, resolves to rescue his brother, who'd been abducted by the Kingdom of Nahara—a nation that places its highest value on conquest and expansion.

Yet, his path is obstructed by the very instinct for conflict, the duality of good and evil, that has been ingrained within him.

This is the story of those who confront and battle against the deep-seated prejudices that plague their world.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13508]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
在一个善恶分明的世界里，住着两位极其美丽的王子。

尽管两人原本来自同一个王国，但有一天，双胞胎中的长子阿夫南王子却消失得无影无踪。

阿姆贾德王国是一个崇尚正义和人性本质善良的王国，纳杰夫王子决心营救被纳哈拉王国（一个以征服和扩张为最高价值的国家）绑架的兄弟。

然而，他的道路被他内心根深蒂固的冲突本能、善恶二元性所阻碍。

这是一个关于那些与困扰他们的世界的根深蒂固的偏见作斗争的人的故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13508]Novelgame[/url]]
